I1.detail: Own input visibility and accessible state changed once; neighbor remained masked with original value.

I2.detail: Native Enter and Space each toggled exactly once.

I3.detail: Two decoded local 2x2 images, independent URLs, literal filename markup with no child elements.

I4.detail: Reselect and clear revoked each prior URL exactly once; neighbor retained.

I5.detail: Invalid PNG bytes caused an actual image decode failure, released failed/previous URLs, and removed stale success.

I8.detail: Real independent-child HTTP swap retained owner/body identities, displayed image and live URL.

I9.detail: Dependent-child removal released only its resource under retained owner; full-root HTTP replacement removed owner and released only its URL; neighbor remained usable.

I7.detail: Three additional real dependent-child/full-root cycles; new controls usable and each activation/allocation produced exactly one effect.

I6.detail: Captured 31 actual outgoing HTMX requests with HTTP200 HTML and changed server revision markers.

I11.detail: Core plus two external feature scripts each fetched once per page; all actual fragment response HTML contains no executable script.

I10.detail: Both custom feature responses replaced with empty scripts by labelled harness injection; native disclosure opened/closed using keyboard.

I12.detail: Actual Django system check exit0; primary browser console errors and pageerrors empty, including handled invalid decode.
